news.title: Argon introductory API pricing
news.summary: $2 input / $10 output per million tokens through November 30, then $4 / $20. API offer only; subscription allowances are separate.

news.title: Gemini 4 Argon broadly available
news.summary: Independent AutomationBench: 78% versus Sol Medium 63%, at $1.99 versus $0.21 per benchmark task. More capability comes at a higher task cost.

news.title: Sonnet 5.5 cache reads halved
news.summary: Cache reads fell to $0.10 per million tokens. Anthropic estimates about 20% lower cost on most agentic tasks; this is a vendor claim, not a measured subscription saving.

review.note: Analyst reviewed 2026-10-24. Unavailable and frozen rows retain historical dates. Material citation conflicts were corrected after direct source recovery. Independent API task costs, vendor-reported charts and subscription allowances remain separate. Local model scores and checked dates are unchanged. Recommendations were reviewed against the value rule with explicit task-specific exceptions and availability limits. The overall value leader remains Sol medium.

overall_value_leader.basis: Balanced capability and cost for everyday, multistep work. Use the task-specific picks below when your work needs something different.

subscription_promotions.name: Claude artifact usage promotion
subscription_promotions.scope: Free (from October 7), Pro, Max and Team; excludes Enterprise. Eligible Claude chats and cloud tasks in the Claude app only.
subscription_promotions.benefit: 50% less five-hour session usage for eligible artifact work; approximately 2x eligible session capacity, not a blanket token discount.
subscription_promotions.limits: Chat: next 10 messages after an artifact edit, up to the first 15 steps per reply. Cloud tasks in the Claude app: about 45 minutes when starting with Document, Presentation or Design, or up to 80 steps after an artifact edit.
subscription_promotions.exclusions: No Claude API, Claude Code, local desktop tasks in the Claude app, scheduled/unattended tasks, usage-credit charges, older artifacts, standalone Claude Design, or Google Drive-created Docs/Sheets/Slides. Weekly allowance is unchanged.
subscription_promotions.recommendation: For eligible document, slide and design work, consider Claude during this offer to stretch the five-hour allowance. Choose the lowest model and effort that passes your checks. API benchmark costs do not measure subscription allowance; no cross-vendor subscription winner is established.

rule: An upgrade pays when it adds at least 5 points (or 75 Elo on GDPval) for each doubling of cost per task. Below that, the cheaper setting is the sweet spot.
